analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI is hovering after entering oversold territory, and MACD histogram continues to worsen. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.84 times the 5-day average, indicating no confirmed trend reversal signal.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($73,265) vs SMA5 ($74,826)/SMA20 ($81,307)/SMA50 ($92,618): below short/mid-term trends, confirming weak positioning
· Significantly lower than SMA100 ($100,001)/SMA200 ($101,098): diagnosing weakened long-term trend
· 52-week position (18.9%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 38.7 → 35.5 (entering oversold territory): confirming continued weak momentum
· MACD histogram 42.9123 → -211.4395 (continuing to worsen): signaling strengthening downtrend
· Bollinger Bands current price position (near lower band $70,110): approaching lower band, exploring rebound potential
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($72,060): confirming support based on Pivot S1 ($65,310) and 5-day/20-day lows ($71,505)
· Swing resistance ($86,590): exploring potential trend reversal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways): confirming lack of clear direction
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.84x): diagnosing subdued confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase): maintaining wait-and-see conditions due to absence of clear buy/sell signals
